notes.title: Game Update - 20250921
notes.content: [p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630347/e38cd14901c10423ff4c38dc934bcc7624405f2f.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Update - September 20, 2025[/p][p align="start"]Optimizations:[/p][olist][*][p]Optimized the pop-up mechanism in the prologue.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some descriptive texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the prompts for the nightclub door on the mid-level entertainment street of the dome.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collisions for certain buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the guidance path for key clue progression to ensure a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the spider sound effects to make them more natural.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Bug Fixes:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where falling in some scenes provided no feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clipping issues in certain scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI lag problems.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Tip: Thank you for your support, players![/p]
